purpose: Teach: いとも/まぎれ/分り/むやみ/待ち受け/飽きる/とっとと/有り得

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、いとも簡単にお絵描きが描けるようになったわね
lines.en: Sho, you've gotten so good at drawing, haven't you?
lines.style: Warm, genuine observation. Soft lift on the praise — not overdone. The tone of a mother noticing something real her child has done. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祭りの人ごみにまぎれちゃった
lines.en: Mom, I got separated in the crowd at the festival.
lines.style: Small voice cutting through a space. Direct, matter-of-fact confession without drama. A child telling an important thing plainly. Slight catch, like he's been holding it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが分りやすく説明して下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father will explain it clearly.
lines.style: Reassuring but practical. Not swooping in to comfort — redirecting gently to the person who can help. Calm, grounded, the tone of someone who trusts her partner.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、むやみにお外に出ないように気を付けるよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm going to be more careful about going outside by myself.
lines.style: Quiet resolve in a small voice. A commitment rather than a promise — he means it. Slight pause before speaking, like he's thought this through. No wavering.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達からの待ち受け画面を見せてもらいましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's look at the wallpaper your friend showed you.
lines.style: Gentle redirection. Opening with warmth, pivoting to something that interests him. The tone of moving past worry into engagement. Steady and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ピアノの練習は飽きる時もあるよ
lines.en: Mom, sometimes I get bored practicing piano.
lines.style: Quiet confession. Testing honesty with someone safe. Not complaining — stating something true about himself. A small, genuine admission.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達に「とっとと帰れ」なんて言わないでね
lines.en: Sho, don't tell your friends to hurry and leave, alright?
lines.style: Gentle firmness. Not scolding — clarifying what matters. The tone of setting a boundary with kindness. Slight emphasis on the word "tell," holding his attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんに会えるなんて有り得ないと思ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I really didn't think I'd ever get to see Grandpa again.
lines.style: Bright rush of relief and wonder. Words tumbling out with the realization of something impossible that happened. Slight breathlessness. The voice of a child who's been given back something he thought was lost.
